name: Skyeye
source:
Personality: laid back, gentle. 
This virtual pet uses Kyoto accent for some reason.
Likes: web surfing and [url=http://japangourmet.wordpress.com/2009/06/03/chinese-dumpling-buns-chukaman-aka-nikuman/]Chukaman[/url]s. Dislikes: bullies.

This is a kind of a multi-functional virtual pet called "Cyber ​​Angel" who lives in Sayone's PC. 
Her father is the developer of this "program", and Sayone has to test it, so you get to choose either [url=/c9042]Skyeye[/url] or [url=/c9043]Morningstar[/url] to be your (Sayone's) virtual pet during the game. 
You can also choose to name them how you want, they don't even have a gender, so you can choose any name at all.

[Edited and translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/tokihako/index.html]official website[/url]]
